subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: When an explicitly requested `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` address is unavailable or unbindable, should startup fail, or should OpenClaw retain local-only degraded operation with prominent diagnostics?
rationale: The existing fallback is intentional and documented, so replacing it with fatal startup changes a compatibility-sensitive availability contract rather than fixing an accidental network exposure.

options.title: Diagnose degraded local mode
options.body: Keep the loopback fallback, but warn prominently and report both requested and effective bind state in gateway diagnostics.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet startup
options.body: Make an unavailable or unbindable explicit Tailnet address terminate startup with a non-zero exit code, accepting the compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Diagnose degraded local mode
recommendation.body: Keep the loopback fallback, but warn prominently and report both requested and effective bind state in gateway diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline explicitly routed this gateway product decision to steipete, making them the best available decision owner despite limited commit-level provenance.
